models.mechanism: Refuge is close nurture through concealment and emergence: created life passes through a dark hidden interval, is split safely into manifestation, and is guarded as a fresh benefaction from an agent who wants the blessing removed.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: newly delivered mother staying with her young
activation_trace.assigned_role: protective nearness around vulnerable new life

activation_trace.literal_contribution: nurture and completion stage by stage

activation_trace.assigned_role: the good whose continuance is protected
the agentive threat to emergent benefaction

structural_cues: الفلق/خلق converge on bringing-forth, while غاسق إذا وقب supplies a preceding concealment phase.
ر ب ب B009/B016 and ح س د B001 oppose fresh benefaction to desired removal.
The repeated مِن شَرِّ attaches the final agentive threat to the same refuge begun in 113:1.

abductive_moves.assumption: The created thing brought through darkness is modeled as a fresh blessing vulnerable to envy.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies emergence, freshness, benefaction, and envy but does not identify one object across them.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: emergent benefaction → perceived by envier → desired removal
alternatives: the envied blessing is unrelated to emergence
darkness is only an external danger

abductive_moves.assumption: Nurture preserves the blessing against removal through the entire hidden-to-visible passage.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The protective arrow from lordly care to continued possession is unstated.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: stage-by-stage care → safe emergence and continuance
alternatives: the blessing is replaced rather than preserved

changed_reading.before: The focus asked for shelter with the Lord of daybreak.
changed_reading.after: It asks a caregiver of emerging life to preserve a fresh benefaction through concealment, manifestation, and another's wish that it disappear.

minimal_triggers: 113:3 غ س ق B001 and و ق ب B002
models.ablation: Remove 113:2 and the emergence link becomes only dormant; remove 113:3 and the protected hidden phase collapses; remove 113:5 and the blessing-removal threat disappears; remove the focus's ع و ذ/rabb cluster and only a creation cycle remains.

models.mechanism: The Lord of الفلق governs separation so it produces proportioned form rather than destructive shredding or subtraction. Creation measures before cutting and completes form; evil can shred; envy seeks removal of an already given good. Refuge asks that differentiation remain generative and that neither fragmentation nor dispossessive subtraction undo created form.

activation_trace.assigned_role: social subtraction parallel to material destruction

structural_cues: 113:1-2 juxtapose الفلق, شر, and خلق, aligning opening, harm, and formation.
ف ل ق B003 and ش ر ر B004 reverse the value of splitting.
113:5 adds removal as the envier's intended outcome, echoing destructive subtraction rather than generative differentiation.

abductive_moves.assumption: The cutting images across ف ل ق, خ ل ق, and ش ر ر form one regulated-versus-destructive mechanism.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Their shared material logic is lexical, not explicitly asserted.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: measure and governance → generative cleavage → completed form; lost measure → shredding

abductive_moves.assumption: Envious removal is a social analogue of destructive cutting-away.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: ح س د B001 gives removal but not a material operation.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: envy's dispossessive aim → subtraction of formed good

changed_reading.before: Lord of daybreak named a temporal sovereign.
changed_reading.after: Lord of الفلق becomes the regulator who distinguishes form-producing separation from fragmentation and removal.

minimal_triggers: 113:1 ر ب ب B002 and ف ل ق B001/B003
113:2 ش ر ر B004 and خ ل ق B001/B003
models.ablation: Remove 113:2 and the measured-creation/destructive-shredding reversal collapses; remove 113:5 and the removal analogue vanishes but the material model survives; remove ف ل ق B001/B003 and the focus no longer supplies the regulated operation.

models.mechanism: Refuge is selective boundary control. Darkness can pour into a recess; a slight mouth-payload is inserted into a compact knot; the Lord of the cleft detects, opens, or seals compromised nodes so harmful input is expelled while sound structure remains.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: entering a hollow and becoming hidden

structural_cues: غ س ق B004 plus و ق ب B001-B002 gives flowing entry into a receptacle.
فِي العقد localizes a second directed input inside a bound node.
ف ل ق opening and ع ق د fastening form a material reversal under رب lordship.

abductive_moves.assumption: Darkness and mouth-emission behave as payloads that can penetrate bounded interiors.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Flow, entry, and فِي are supplied, but penetration effects are not stated.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: mobile input → aperture/node → hidden internal compromise

abductive_moves.assumption: Selective opening removes harmful content without destroying sound bonds.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet does not specify selective repair.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: governed opening → payload released → structure preserved

changed_reading.after: It is governance of porous, bound interfaces against hidden macro- and micro-intrusion.

minimal_triggers: 113:1 ر ب ب B001 and ف ل ق B001/B004
113:3 غ س ق B004 and و ق ب B001-B002
113:4 ن ف ث B001, ع ق د B001/B016, and فِي
models.ablation: Remove 113:3 and broad ingress disappears; remove 113:4 and node-level insertion disappears; remove ف ل ق B001/B004 and the focus supplies no aperture response; remove rabb B001 and there is no regulator.

models.mechanism: قُلْ أَعُوذُ is an enacted protective mouth-operation opposed to hostile mouth-output directed into spell-knots. Invoking the Lord of opening and clarification is assigned the role of exposing and unbinding what the rival operation fastens.
structural_cues: The sequence starts with قُلْ and later names another mouth act.
ع و ذ B002 and ن ف ث B001 supply rival protective/harmful practices.
الفلق and العقد reverse opening and binding; بِرَبِّ and فِي العقد contrast orientation to authority with insertion into a target.

abductive_moves.assumption: The commanded invocation neutralizes the knot-directed blow.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The two operations are listed but their interaction is unstated.

changed_reading.before: An instruction to report a refuge request.
changed_reading.after: A spoken counter-operation invoking divine opening against a mouth-act of binding.

minimal_triggers: 113:4 ن ف ث B001 and ع ق د B013
models.ablation: Remove 113:4 and the rival mouth-binding operation vanishes, leaving a generic invocation; remove q-w-l/a-w-dh and no counter-act is performed; remove f-l-q and the unbinding mechanism collapses.

models.mechanism: When darkness enters and the eye loses light, the commanded utterance supplies an audible sign that maintains orientation toward the Lord of disclosure until clarification returns.
structural_cues: قُلْ precedes an eye-darkening branch, placing speech beside failed sight.
الفلق and غاسق إذا وقب reverse disclosure/concealment.
إِذَا marks the moment the alternate channel becomes relevant.

abductive_moves.assumption: Audible speech substitutes for visual guidance.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: Speech, indication, and eye-darkening are supplied separately.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: visual loss → voiced sign → maintained orientation

changed_reading.before: The focus merely requested protection during night.
changed_reading.after: It supplies an audible compass when concealment removes visual cues.

minimal_triggers: 113:3 غ س ق B003 and و ق ب B002
models.ablation: Remove 113:3 غ س ق B003 and sensory substitution collapses; remove q-w-l B001/B014 and no audible indication remains; remove f-l-q B002 and it has no disclosure-pole.

models.mechanism: قُلْ moves an inner saying into articulation; chest-burdened نفث supplies venting; عقد supplies a knotted tongue and tangled discourse; the Lord of الفلق repairs expression by opening the blockage and clarifying speech.
structural_cues: قُلْ and العقد frame the sequence with articulation and blockage.
ن ف ث B003 and ق و ل B012→B001 share inner-to-outer movement.
ف ل ق B001-B002 reverses ع ق د B007's entanglement.

abductive_moves.assumption: The plural knots activates the tongue-knot branch.
Protective articulation safely vents and repairs the blockage.

changed_reading.before: The focus gave a refuge formula.
changed_reading.after: It commands safe release of an inner burden through a repaired, unknotted tongue.

minimal_triggers: 113:4 ن ف ث B003 and ع ق د B007
models.ablation: Remove 113:4 ع ق د B007 and there is no expressive blockage; remove ن ف ث B003 and no chest-venting bridge; remove q-w-l B012/B001 and no inner-to-outer transition; remove f-l-q B002 and release lacks clarification.

models.mechanism: Refuge protects the gap between harmful capacity and enacted completion. Darkness becomes dangerous when it enters; a slight mouth-input can harden into a knot; an envier becomes the specified threat when envy is enacted. ع و ذ B006 and الفلق supply failure of completion and reopening, so exposure or disposition need not determine the final outcome.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: escape after fright or contact without intended killing completed
envy that may actively seek removal

structural_cues: غاسق إذا وقب and حاسد إذا حسد repeat noun + إِذَا + enacted verb, distinguishing bearer/state from activated event.
نفث→عقد B003 supplies a slight-start-to-hardening sequence.
ع و ذ B006 lexically distinguishes attempted harm from completed result; الفلق reverses closure and night.

abductive_moves.assumption: The repeated إِذَا structures mark transitions from capacity to harmful enactment.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The grammar marks timing but not a general causal theory.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: latent state/agent → triggering enactment → possible harm

abductive_moves.assumption: Refuge interrupts after onset but before determination of outcome.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The protective interruption arrow is unstated.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: lordly intervention → consolidation/action fails to complete → survival
alternatives: harm completes but is later compensated

changed_reading.before: Refuge meant avoiding dangerous beings or states.
changed_reading.after: It protects contingency itself: darkness, slight contact, or envy may activate, yet need not harden into completed harm.

minimal_triggers: 113:1 ع و ذ B006 and ف ل ق B001-B002
113:3 غ س ق/و ق ب with إِذَا
113:4 ن ف ث B001 and ع ق د B003
113:5 خ ل ق B004, ح س د B001, and حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
models.ablation: Remove 113:5 and the disposition-to-action distinction loses its clearest human form; remove 113:3 and the repeated activation syntax vanishes; remove 113:4 and progressive hardening vanishes; remove ع و ذ B006 and there is no failed-completion branch.

models.mechanism: False or circulating mouth-output can enter covenants, convictions, affection, and brotherhood, knotting them into hostility. The envier's wish to remove another's blessing supplies a motive for that insinuation. Refuge with the Lord of clarification asks that malicious attribution be separated from valid bonds while those bonds and blessings remain.
structural_cues: قُلْ and a later mouth-act place the sequence in a speech field.
العقد plural permits multiple social binding-sites; q-w-l and a-q-d branches independently converge on reports affecting bonds.
113:5 supplies an agent, motive, and enacted condition for the previously anonymous insinuation.

abductive_moves.assumption: The mouth-blow models false or circulating speech entering relationships.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: envy-motivated report → bond penetrated → mistrust/anger fixed

abductive_moves.assumption: Clarification can remove false content without severing the bond.

changed_reading.before: Refuge protected the individual from an unspecified envier.
changed_reading.after: It protects the social fabric and its blessings from envy-motivated insinuation while preserving valid attachment.

models.ablation: Remove 113:4 and the bond-penetration mechanism collapses; remove 113:5 and its motive becomes generic malice; remove q-w-l B005/B007 and no false-report channel remains; remove f-l-q B002 and there is no exposure response.

models.mechanism: The final verse activates a distributive reading. Rabb can name benefaction and stage-by-stage increase; الفلق/خلق bring new things forth; envy can either wish the other's blessing removed or emulate it without dispossession. The Lord of الفلق is thus the source of generative abundance: refuge rejects zero-sum removal while leaving open non-destructive desire for a like good.

activation_trace.assigned_role: capacity to create another good rather than transfer one

activation_trace.literal_contribution: wishing another's blessing removed or transferred
wishing for a like blessing without loss to its owner

structural_cues: ح س د occurs twice as agent and act, foregrounding which branch is enacted.
مِن شَرِّ scopes the harmful predicate, while the inventory's B002 preserves a non-dispossessive alternative rather than condemning all comparison.
ر ب ب B016 and ح س د B001 share the exact object-type of blessing; الفلق/خلق supply generation as an alternative to transfer/removal.

abductive_moves.assumption: Creation can answer comparative desire by generating another good rather than reallocating the first.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet gives creation and two envy branches but not this distributive solution.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: generative lordship → additional benefaction → emulation without dispossession

abductive_moves.assumption: The evil condition is the transition from emulation to active removal-wishing.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The verse says when the envier envies, but does not explicitly distinguish B001 from B002 in context.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: comparison → either non-destructive aspiration or dispossessive intent → only latter enters harm mechanism
alternatives: B002 is lexically present but inactive

changed_reading.before: The focus named shelter from an envier.
changed_reading.after: It invokes the generator of fresh benefaction against zero-sum removal, while preserving emulation that seeks a like good without dispossessing anyone.

minimal_triggers: 113:5 ح س د B001-B002 and the repetition حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
models.ablation: Remove 113:5 and the distributive contrast disappears; remove h-s-d B002 and only generic protection from envy remains; remove r-b-b B016 and the shared blessing-object vanishes; remove f-l-q/k-h-l-q generation branches and the non-zero-sum causal alternative collapses.

surprise_reading: Across the full sequence, the focus can be read in nine simultaneously active ways: nurture that preserves an emerging blessing; regulation of constructive cleavage against fragmentation and removal; selective defense of porous bound nodes; a spoken counter-operation against binding breath; audible orientation when sight fails; release of chest-burden through an unknotted tongue; interruption between harmful capacity and completed action; clarification that protects social bonds from envy-driven insinuation; and generative abundance that answers comparison without dispossessing another.
discarded_or_unchanged: The stage-0 prison-stocks polarity was displaced by stronger contextual mechanisms and is not preserved as active.
